muc.title: Afraid of being misread
muc.text: Your child says they were bullied, and you want to message the teacher without sounding accusing. AI helps you word it well.

muc.title: Thanks, facts, request
muc.text: A tactful message has three parts: thank the teacher, briefly describe what happened, then propose helping the child together.

muc.title: Remove harsh words
muc.text: It's fine to draft it emotionally, then ask AI to keep the main point and drop the harsh words.

muc.title: Rename before pasting
muc.text: Before pasting into AI, rename the children to child A and child B. For serious matters, ask to meet the teacher in person.

muc.title: Three tones
muc.text: Ask a chatbot to write a sick-day message for your child in three tones: brief, warm and formal.
